title: Kenworth T-604-T609 hi-tensile Aluminium FUPS Bullbar #20
description: Kenworth T Series T604-T609 hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar Kentucky style aero channel. Standard 76mm diameter pipe and four heavy duty box upright posts, but optional 88mm pipe can be ordered. Custom fitted driving light extrusion mounts to the lower and centre bars, ideal for light bars. Heavy duty wrap around end plates. Heavy duty steel backing plate with 38mm pin.
